'''Takobo Spaceport Depot''' was a business in a local [[spaceport]] in [[Takobo City]], the [[capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Takobo]]. The name of the business was written in [[Color|red]] [[Aurebesh]] letters over a doorway outside a [[hangar]] area. The archway outside the door had a design similar to<ref name="Force" /> the entrance arch at [[Niima Outpost]] on the planet [[Jakku]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The archway outside the entrance to the depot was originally designed by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba the Hutt's palace]] in the [[1983]] film {{Film|6}}.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
